mapper.select: SELECT user_id, role_cd, use_yn, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM user_auth_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_auth_profile (user_id, role_cd, use_yn, reg_id, update_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleCd}, #{useYn}, #{regId}, #{updateId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET role_cd = EXCLUDED.role_cd, use_yn = EXCLUDED.use_yn, update_id = EXCLUDED.update_id
